test_migrate_thread_dirs_moves_thread_to: test that migrate_thread_dirs moves a thread directory to the correct user-specific path
test_migrate_thread_dirs_unowned_thread_: test that unowned threads are migrated to the default user directory
test_migrate_thread_dirs_idempotent_skip: test that migrate_thread_dirs skips threads already migrated to their destination
test_migrate_thread_dirs_conflict_preser: test that existing destination data is preserved and legacy data is saved to migration-conflicts
test_migrate_thread_dirs_dry_run_does_no: test that migrate_thread_dirs with dry_run true reports changes without moving files
